explanation: Its Odessa Steps sequence, with a baby carriage (pram) bouncing down the stairs, has been copied many times, including in The Untouchables (1987).

claims.text: Andrei Tarkovsky, Dziga Vertov and Vsevolod Pudovkin did not direct Battleship Potemkin; Tarkovsky's career began in the 1960s.
The film's Odessa Steps sequence shows a baby carriage rolling down the steps.
The Untouchables (1987) restages the falling baby carriage on a station staircase.
